title: PlanNightCallablePayload
description: Command night.plan (contracts/commands/catalog.json; #2062 C4). A phone-verified caller with a try-it workspace names a format and a guest count. Preview answers the night: groups, the mixing moment, the run of show, three missions and a rehearsal setup, all from the shared playbook-shape catalog. Apply saves it as the event-success plan of the workspace's private draft event (or input.eventId, which must belong to the workspace) once that event's activity matches the format.

guestCount.description: Up to 1000, the plan contract's targetAttendeeCount bound.

eventId.description: A draft event in the caller's try-it workspace to plan. Defaults to the workspace's newest private try-it draft.
